title: Cargo.toml: no dev-dependency scope for test-only deps like tokio-stream/sync
description: In kith-events/Cargo.toml, tokio-stream with the 'sync' feature is listed as a regular [dependency] because it is used in the test that exercises BroadcastStream. But tokio-stream is only used in #[cfg(test)] code inside lib.rs. It should be a [dev-dependencies] entry so it is not linked into the production binary. Currently any crate depending on kith-events gets tokio-stream as a transitive dependency even though the production code does not use it. Move tokio-stream to [dev-dependencies] in kith-events.
